full_details: You were at St Helen's. Master Thwaite prayed for Cornwall and for Devon, and he prayed forty of the Queen's ships. You knew four galleys, and Mousehole, Newlyn, Penzance, and the church at Paul. You did not say the number. After dinner you opened the coffer. Six pounds went into a linen belt. Twenty pound and eight shillings stayed under two locks. Mistress Ansell argued the pack. The list ended shorter than hers and shorter than yours. You wiped it once the pack was shut. Brooke stayed on the shelf. Holinshed went under its cloth, and Gib sat on the cloth. You told her a man goes home. Verbeke tied the knot. You were in bed by nine, and it was still light.
one_sentence: You counted twenty-six pound and eight shillings, put six in a belt, and locked the rest.
title: Six pounds in the belt
